rules.name: ouat142-input-sizes
rules.sql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name, c.relname AS table_name, c.reltuples::bigint AS est_rows, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)) AS total_size FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relname IN ('vol_id_table', 'product_master_table', 'marketdata_option_conv_table', 'underlying_list_table', 'underlying_settle_value_table', 'matlab_query_table') ORDER BY c.relname
SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE expiry_date >= CAST(:cob AS date) - 10) AS rows_read_by_pipeline FROM opera.vol_id_table GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY total_rows DESC
SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS settle_rows FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE settlement_date = CAST(:cob AS date) GROUP BY tenant_id
SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS live_rows FROM opera.underlying_list_table WHERE expiry_date >= CAST(:cob AS date) GROUP BY tenant_id

SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS rows_total, COUNT(option_tick_size) AS with_tick FROM opera.product_master_table WHERE asset_class NOT IN ('index', 'currency', 'bond', 'money market') GROUP BY tenant_id
SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS rows_total FROM opera.marketdata_option_conv_table GROUP BY tenant_id
